scripts.db:migrar: for f in migraciones/*.sql; do /Applications/Postgres.app/Contents/Versions/18/bin/psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d conciliador -f $f || exit 1; done
scripts.db:test:reiniciar: PG=/Applications/Postgres.app/Contents/Versions/18/bin; $PG/dropdb --if-exists conciliador_test && $PG/createdb conciliador_test && for f in migraciones/*.sql; do $PG/psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d conciliador_test -f $f || exit 1; done
